title: Linked list nodes and links
summary: The figure consists of a logical view and a memory grid showing the same linked list. In the grid, each node occupies two adjacent cells storing its value and its successor reference next (pointer); the remaining light-colored cells represent free memory, with cell sizes shown schematically.

frames.title: Linked list nodes and links
frames.explanation: The linked list has 5 nodes connected along next references as 1 → 3 → 2 → 5 → 4 → None. The head node is 1, the tail node is 4, and None indicates that there is no next node. In the memory grid, nodes 2 and 5 sit lower down while the tail node 4 sits near the top: node 5's next still points to 4, showing that logical order is determined by references rather than physical location.
